page.overview:
Who is Twyla Barsha?

Twyla Barsha was a human female member of the Barsha family, serving as an executive board member for the Barsha Corporation on their executive board.

Twyla Barsha appeared in the 2026 novel Star Wars Outlaws: Low Red Moon, written by Mike Chen.
